proof.range: All real q >= 0 and K > 0, with t=sqrt(1+q)>=1; no upper restriction on q.
proof.kernel: Write Delta F=e^(iK phi_PP)[A-A_PP+A(expm1(iK Delta phi))]. Use |expm1(iu)|<=|u| for real u and |A|<=sqrt(1+1/K^2).
proof.field_bounds: Triangle inequality pointwise in the area integral for B0 and in the fixed-AR boundary transport integral for B1; then use monotonicity of the ROI L2 norm.
proof.prediction_bounds: Reverse triangle inequality gives |D-D_tilde|<=B0. Also |N-||U_PP||||<=B0, so if B0<||U_PP|| then N>=||U_PP||-B0>0, yielding the practical common-factor bound.
proof.sensitivity_bound: In the real inner product Re<.,.>, derivative of ||X|| is Re<X/||X||,X'> at nonzero X. For X=U_RS-U_F and Y=U_PP-U_F, ||X/||X||-Y/||Y||||<=2||X-Y||/min(||X||,||Y||) by the triangle and reverse triangle inequalities. Hence |D'-D_tilde'|<=B1+2B0||Y'||/min(D,D_tilde). The quotient rule and |N'|<=||U_RS'|| give the proposed BS. Requires differentiable fields and N,D,D_tilde>0.

arithmetic: Arb outward rounding; decimal display approximations are for plots only.
scope: Certified midpoint boundary and interval ROI enclosure, not the empirical GL evaluator.
benchmark_scope: Sampled A/B and continuous C are different tasks; no matched-accuracy speedup is claimed.
